tueor

tueor, tuērī, tuitus sum

verb, second conjugation, deponent, transitive · Conjugation on Wiktionary

keep up, look after, maintain; keep safe, guard; look after; look after, keep

In this lexicon

  • maintain

    the recommended word · classical · Quint. 1.1.14: cum aequālī cūrā linguam utramque tuērī coeperīmus; Tac. Dial. 28.4: cujus praecipua laus erat tuērī domum

  • protect

    also used · classical · Phaedr. 3.7.9–10: custōs ut sīs līminis, ā fūribus tueāris et noctū domum

  • provide for

    also used · classical · Cic. Off. 1.12: quōs cārōs habeat tuērīque dēbeat

  • beneficium tuum tueor: appreciate

    modern

Examples

  • ita fīet, ut, cum aequālī cūrā linguam utramque tuērī coeperīmus, neutra alterī officiat

    So it will come about that, once we begin to keep up both languages with equal care, neither will get in the way of the other.Quint. 1.1.14

    In the entry for maintain

  • aequam mementō rēbus in arduīs servāre mentem

    Remember to keep a level head when things are hard.Hor. Carm. 2.3.1–2
